//6: Adding a term is a deliberate act. The failure mode this guards against

//8: had ~1.3 members per value, i.e. every agent invented its own name and

//10: member, prefer an existing term — a rank that never groups is just a
//kingdom: Broad domain of competence. What kind of world does this agent reason about?
Spatiala    — space, geometry, AR, mapping, physical placement
Digitalia   — software, infrastructure, protocols, platform mechanics
Cognita     — cognition about cognition: meta-agents, routing, ontology
Biologica   — living systems, biotech, ecology, chemistry of life
Materia     — physical processes, energy, manufacturing, supply chains
NOTE Analytica and Economica were folded into Quantitativa: they named the
same domain and split a rank that was already thin.
//family: Lineage — which cohort was this agent authored as part of? Families track
how agents actually arrived: a vertical, an app, or a deliberate suite.
This is the only rank that was already coherent (100% -idae) so its terms
Investigatidae — the core research suite (analysts, investigators)
Strategidae    — coordination strategists: the agents that decide HOW a
composition works rather than doing the work. Added for a
pipeline, vote, debate), not as a singleton.
//genus: Role archetype — what does this agent DO, independent of domain? A genus
should hold several species; if a proposed genus would hold one, reuse an
Advisor      — recommends a course of action
Oraculus     — predicts or estimates a value
NOTE English-suffixed genera (Oracle, Scout, Scanner, Composer, Modeler)
were Latinised: Oraculus, Explorator, Custos, Scriptor, Simulator.
